The big screen plays a live kiss cam with a heart-shaped frame. (1) The screen cuts to the two people from the photo sitting at a table among the other diners, both laughing at something. (2) They look up, see themselves on the screen, and one slides down in the chair to hide behind a menu while the other points at a stranger at the next table as if to say 'not us'. (3) Kids at the nearby tables laugh and point at the screen. Audio: restaurant chatter, cutlery, a cheerful original jingle from the speakers, laughter.
